title: 第93章 热闹的李青山家

第93章 热闹的李青山家-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“汪汪汪！”

李青山刚到后院，几只狼狗崽子在大黄的带领下，便朝着自己跑了过来，一个个吃的虎头虎脑的，不断在自己膝下打滚，转圈，摇着尾巴……！

别看现在这些狼狗还小，等到明年这个时候，站起来能有一人多高，牙口锋利，性情勇猛，每一个都是狩猎的好帮手，而且有大黄这只慈父带着，就算是自己什么都不训练，这些狼狗也能被大黄影响着学习一些狩猎的技巧。

狗盆内，是煮熟的鱼肠子内脏之类的残羹，都吃的差不多了。

九个狗窝垒的跟个小房子一样，一只狗一个窝，一个狗盆，等到下次上山倒是可以活捉几只野兔子带来给这些狼狗崽子玩一玩，练习练习狩猎的技巧。

后院的木围子也扩大了不少，山坡的几棵树被围了进来，香獐子也有了可以避暑的好去处。

李青山看了一圈后，便回到了前院！

浓郁的酱香和鱼肉的香味，扑鼻而来，两口大铁锅蒸腾着热气，灶台下的火焰熊熊燃烧，一家人手中的活都忙活的差不多了，都在等着炖鱼出锅。

院子内。

是满满当当的咸鱼干，足足五百斤，排列整齐，被挂在竹竿子上，足够一家人吃上很久了。

大铁锅里面的炖鱼还要一会，李青山便出了门，去将柔雪和她闺女小草也一起喊来热闹，柔雪本来是不好意思来的，但耐不住小草和李青山的坚持，便只好点头答应一起起来。

“三奶奶！”

院子内，李青山刚带着柔雪进院子，小草便一路小跑冲到了自己老娘韩秀的怀中，这可让自家老娘韩秀喜欢的紧道：“小草来了啊，走，三奶奶带你拿好吃的。”

说罢，便满脸笑意的领着小草朝着房间内走去。

“行了，炖鱼也差不多好了，出锅吧！”

李三奎话音落下，院子内前来帮忙的汉子和女人们，纷纷咽着口水朝着大铁锅走了过去。

望着满满当当的鱼肉和豆腐，蘑菇落在自己的碗里，还冒着热腾的蒸汽和开口的香味，一个个早就迫不及待了，连忙大口大口咬着手中的饼子，再夹着碗中的鱼肉。

李青山家院子的周围，围了不少还没走的村民。

望着院子内的景象，一个个忍不住暗自咽着口水，脸上满是向往之色。

早知道如此，自己无论如何也要争取一下去给李青山家中帮工的机会了，要是那样的话，现在坐在院子里吃肥美大鱼的，可就是自己了啊！！

"Woof woof woof!"

As soon as Li Qingshan arrived in the backyard, several wolf and dog cubs, led by Dahuang, ran towards him. Each one of them was devouring themselves, rolling under his knees, spinning in circles, wagging their tails...!

Even though these wolfdogs are still small now, by this time next year, they will be as tall as a person, with sharp teeth and fierce temperaments. Each one of them is a good helper in hunting, and with Rhubarb as his loving father, these wolfdogs can be influenced by Rhubarb to learn some hunting skills even if they don't train anything.

In the dog bowl, there were leftovers such as cooked fish intestines and offal, which were almost eaten.

The nine kennels are built like a small house, with one kennel and one dog basin for each dog. Next time when we go up the mountain, we can catch a few wild rabbits alive and bring them to these wolf and dog cubs to play with and practice their hunting skills.

The wooden fence in the backyard has also been expanded a lot, and several trees on the hillside have been enclosed, giving Fragrant Deer a good place to escape the summer heat.

After Li Qingshan looked around, he returned to the front yard!

The rich aroma of soy sauce and fish fills the nostrils, two large iron pots are steaming with steam, and the flames under the stove are burning brightly. The family is almost busy with their work, waiting for the stewed fish to come out of the pot.

In the courtyard.

It was full of dried salted fish, weighing five hundred kilograms, neatly arranged and hung on bamboo poles. It was enough for a family to eat for a long time.

The fish stew in the big iron pot was still going on for a while, so Li Qingshan went out and called Rouxue and her daughter Xiaocao to join in the fun. Rouxue was originally embarrassed to come, but couldn't bear Xiaocao and Li Qingshan's insistence, so she had no choice but to nod and agree to join them.

"Third Grandma!"

In the yard, as soon as Li Qingshan brought Rouxue into the yard, Xiaocao ran all the way and rushed into the arms of his mother Han Xiu. This made her mother Han Xiu like it and said: "Xiaocao is here, come on, Third Grandma will take you to get something delicious."

After saying that, he led Xiaocao towards the room with a smile on his face.

"Okay, the fish stew is almost ready, let's take it out of the pot!"

After Li Sankui finished speaking, the men and women who came to help in the yard all swallowed their saliva and walked towards the big iron pot.

Looking at the piles of fish, tofu, and mushrooms falling into their own bowls, with the hot steam and fragrant aroma coming out, they all couldn't wait. They quickly took big bites of the pancakes in their hands, and then sandwiched the fish in the bowl.

Around the yard of Li Qingshan's house, there were many villagers who had not yet left.

Looking at the scene in the yard, everyone couldn't help but swallow secretly, their faces full of yearning.

If I had known this, I would have fought for the opportunity to help Li Qingshan's family no matter what. If that were the case, I would be the one sitting in the yard eating fat fish!!
